newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Rocky Notionnel eyes support at 130.88.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Rocky Notionnel eyes support at 130.88.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on the MATIF must hold above support from a recent high at 130.88, if they are to confirm the move higher made in the previous session, technical analysts said on Thursday.
Analysts said the French contract had failed to justify the break higher made Wednesday to a new contract high at 131.24, as it had given back ground by the end of the session, closing at 131.02.
"Notionnel is a big disappointment," said Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at the London Bond Broking Company here. "It's not going to get any further if it can't hold above the 130.80/88 support."
September notionnel futures were up 0.02 at 131.04 by 0750 GMT, after earlier reaching a low of 130.90.

Ostwald said a break below the 130.88 level would negate the upmove and leave the market vulnerable to a correction. He said notionnel would in that case move back to test the highs from last week in the 130.60 area.
Richard Adcock, manager of research at HSBC Futures said in a research note the completion of a bullish flag pattern confirms the chances of further upside to his target of 132.00.
"Short term corrections are a possibility but these should be well supported at 130.84 to offer buying opportunities."
Ostwald said a break above the contract high would target initial resistance at 131.56, a high on continuation charts in March.
"Above there 131.88 is the next resistance," said Ostwald.
At the short end, September PIBOR futures were unchanged at 96.55.
